# Module 1 Knowledge Check

This knowledge check covers the key learning outcomes from Module 1: Getting Started. Test your understanding of pipetting techniques and volume measurement accuracy.

## Question 1: Pipette Volume Accuracy

What is the typical acceptable accuracy range for a micropipette according to the protocol?

- [ ] ±0.5%
- [ ] ±2%
- [ ] ±5%
- [ ] ±10%

## Question 2: Serial Dilution Factor

In the serial dilution protocol described in Module 1, what is the dilution factor used for each transfer?

- [ ] 1:5
- [x] 1:10
- [ ] 1:100
- [ ] Variable

:::{.callout-note}
**Explanation:** The module uses a 1:10 serial dilution, where each tube is diluted 10-fold from the previous. After five dilutions, the final concentration is 1/10^5 or 1/100,000.
:::

## Question 3: Micropipette Mixing

When mixing two liquids in a micropipette tip, what is the correct procedure?

- [x] Press only to the first stop when drawing up, then release slowly
- [ ] Press all the way to the second stop each time
- [ ] Press to the first stop, then to the second stop together
- [ ] Use quick repeated motions to mix thoroughly

:::{.callout-note}
**Explanation:** To mix properly, press only to the first stop to draw the same volume back up. Repeat until mixed. Only press to the second stop at the end when finished dispensing.
:::

## Question 4: Serial Dilution Setup

In the crystal violet serial dilution protocol, how many microliters of water are pipetted into each well of row A?

- [ ] 25 µL
- [x] 50 µL
- [ ] 100 µL
- [ ] 150 µL

:::{.callout-note}
**Explanation:** The protocol specifies 50 µL of water into each well in row A. The same volume of crystal violet solution is then added to well A1 for the dilution series.
:::

## Question 5: Drop Collection Practice

When practicing the drop-collection exercise on the pipette practice card, what should you observe to assess pipetting consistency?

- [ ] Only whether drops stay within the circles
- [x] The relative uniformity of drop size and volume consistency across replicate transfers
- [ ] The color intensity of the dye used
- [ ] How quickly the drops evaporate

:::{.callout-note}
**Explanation:** Consistency in drop size indicates good pipetting technique. Comparing replicate drops of the same volume helps assess your precision and skill level.
:::
